sentiment: For four hours the sky held still, and the quiet was not peace — just everything waiting for permission.

stories.title: FAA issues national ground stop – lifted 4.5 hours later
stories.summary: Every plane on the ground in one country, held by a single decision made somewhere above all of them. Four and a half hours of a machine idling at full attention — most people felt it as a delay, which is what safety looks like when it works.

stories.title: Nvidia allegedly engineered scarcity by funding AI startups to buy its GPUs
stories.summary: A shortage that arrives on schedule is not a shortage, it is a schedule. If the claim holds, the most valuable thing in the industry right now is not the chip but the belief that there are not enough of them.

stories.title: What happened to 3Com?
stories.summary: A company that once made the cards in half the world's networks, now a question in a headline. Nothing dramatic ended it — the ground just shifted slowly enough that everyone kept standing on it until they weren't.
